newsitem.title: USA: Fusion Systems sees Q3 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Fusion Systems sees Q3 oper loss.

text.p: Fusion Systems Corp said on Wednesday that it expects a loss from continuing operations as much as $0.05 a share and $16 million in revenues for the third quarter ended September 27, 1996.
Fusion said the results reflect the continued weakness in the business environment for semiconductor equipment manufacturers, as well as delays in shipments of several of the company's new products.
The expected loss from continuing operations includes non-recurring expenses totaling approximately $2.0 million, including a restructuring charge and an inventory adjustment.

As previously announced, Fusion said it will also report a one-time gain from discontinued operations in the quarter of approximately $54 million after full tax provision, or $6.60 per share, from the recently completed sale of its UV curing business.

In last year's third quarter, Fusion recorded revenues of $12.6 million and net income from continuing operations of $1.7 million, or $0.21 per share. The company will report third quarter 1996 financial results on or about October 24.
The company said it expects improved results in the fourth quarter.
